artworks.title: Pope Leo XIII
artworks.medium: fumée engraving in black on tissue paper
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait of an older man from the chest up. He is facing forward with a gentle expression, slightly raising the corners of his mouth in a subtle smile. His hair is short, light-colored, and thinning on top, revealing a prominent forehead. He has distinguished facial features with deep-set eyes and a slightly pronounced nose. He is wearing a light-colored robe with large buttons. The background is a simple, dark shading, with no visible jewelry or objects in his hands.

artworks.title: Animaux au Pâturage (Animals at Pasture)
artworks.artist: Maxime Lalanne after Nicolaes Pietersz Berchem
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral landscape with cows and goats near a river. On the other side of the river, there are trees, structures, a church, and another tower. The sky has swirling clouds with varying shades of sepia and brown.

artworks.title: The Seine near the Austerlitz Bridge
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on tissue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside cityscape viewed from above. The skyline features buildings and trees, with clouds and smoke in the sky. In the foreground, a woman is leaning forward on a slope or steps leading to the river, where people are gathered. Along the waterfront, there are groups of people engaging in various activities, possibly loading boats. The boats in the river are emitting smoke. The artwork is created using intricate cross-hatching and fine lines to convey texture and depth, giving a sense of movement. The sepia-like palette gives a warm, historical ambiance to the scene.

artworks.title: On the Trail of Don Quixote
artworks.medium: wood engraving in black on tissue paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows three scenes. The first panel shows a cavalier riding a horse under a full moon in rocky terrain. In the second panel, a woman dances on stage in a crowded venue with people seated around tables and a violinist in the corner. The third panel shows a classroom with children around a figure, an easel with chalk, and a crucifix on the wall.

artworks.title: Farmington, Connecticut
artworks.medium: graphite on light brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape sketch with hills, trees, and grass. The horizon is low in the composition. The trees and brush are delicately drawn with pencil strokes. The ground shows patches of grass with thin lines leading towards the horizon. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of gray. The drawing technique involves fine lines for detailed depiction of the scenery.

artworks.title: Gloucester, Massachusetts
artworks.medium: graphite on light brown wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a rocky shoreline viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, overlooking the sea. The horizon aligns with the ocean, where a few small vessels are visible. Rocks of various sizes and textures are detailed in the foreground. The artwork is monochromatic, using shades of gray to create depth. Pencil strokes are varied to add realism to the rocks and water. The scene conveys a sense of tranquility and stillness.

artworks.title: House with a Dovecote in a Rolling Landscape
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic building in a countryside setting. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, with the horizon hidden by vegetation and the building. The image details the textures of the thatched roofs and the surrounding greenery with fine lines, while the sky is depicted with soft brushstrokes. The color scheme is monochromatic with varying intensities of black ink on a cream background. The scene includes a small structure or hut near a natural feature, with trees and bushes scattered around. In the background, the main building with its textured roof is visible, along with birds in the sky. Trees frame the scene, adding to the rural atmosphere.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Figures and a Boat at Water's Edge
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is captured from a slightly elevated point of view showing a wide landscape. A hill with a small structure is in the distance. The etching features detailed brushstrokes emphasizing textures of trees, water, and clouds. A small boat with figures is on a calm river, with a line of trees in the background. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black creating depth and contrast.

artworks.title: A Cottage with Two Men Seated at the Doorway
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view from slightly above ground level of a rustic scene with weathered buildings integrated into the natural landscape. The horizon is not prominently visible, with land rising behind the buildings and sparse trees atop, and a figure standing on the edge of a cliff to the left. The technique used includes detailed etching strokes creating texture and depth, evident in the stonework and foliage. The color palette is monochrome, with variations of black and white emphasizing details and light and shadow. Stone structures and outdoor tools are closest, and figures sit in front of the buildings, suggesting daily life activity. The background merges with trees and rocky slopes, creating a rustic and tranquil environment.

artworks.title: A Low Cottage with a Herdsman Leading His Flock
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a thatched cottage off-center to the right. Surrounding the cottage are trees, forming a border. The scene is depicted from a slightly elevated viewpoint with a monochrome color palette of black and white. A path winds through the terrain, and a small group of animals and a human figure are moving towards the right. In the background, dense trees fade into the sky with light cloud formations.

artworks.title: Horses Being Led to Water on a Winding Riverbank
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene from a side view perspective. The horizon line is low, with land meeting the sky, extending from the left to the center. The sky above is depicted with light line work suggesting cloud formations. In the center right, several stone and wood buildings with steep thatched roofs line a dirt path framed by trees. Closest to us, a rider on a horse is crossing a shallow river or stream, leading another horse. The etching technique uses fine lines and cross-hatching for textural details and contrasts in the architecture, foliage, and water, all in monochrome. The color palette consists of shades of black and white, typical of etching, giving a classic and timeless feel to the scene.

artworks.title: A House and a Shaded Cottage on the Banks of a River
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a serene rural scene with a water feature, a thatched cottage, trees, and foliage. The composition features detailed brushstrokes showcasing textures. The color palette is monochrome with gray and sepia tones. The sky is clear in the background.

artworks.title: Town on a River Bank with Two Round Towers
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront scene with buildings along the edge, trees blocking the horizon, a cylindrical tower with a conical roof, boats with people, and a monochromatic color palette dominated by shades of brown. The etching style includes fine, detailed lines depicting texture and depth in the stones and foliage. Figures are seen in the surroundings, while additional buildings are visible in the distance, hinting at a small town.

artworks.title: Girl with a Candle
artworks.medium: mezzotint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body view of a person leaning out of a window or opening a door. The person is leaning forward slightly, with one arm reaching out to hold the door and the other holding up a lit candle. The facial features are delicate with youthful and serene expressions, and the person has smooth, softly rounded cheeks and a slightly upturned mouth. The hair is styled neatly and tied back, with a ribbon or bow arranged atop the head. The clothing is layered and draped, consisting of a loose-fitting, deep neckline garment, with a shawl or outer garment featuring striped textures and voluminous sleeves. In the background, interior details are visible, such as wooden panels and a soft, dim light setting that complements the candlelight. The background is otherwise nondescript and dark, maintaining the focus on the figure and the immediate area around them.

artworks.title: Harbor with a Large Tower (Le Port de mer à la grosse tour)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to and within plate mark): 13.2 x 19.8 cm (5 3/16 x 7 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with maritime activities. Men are loading goods onto small boats near the shore. A cylindrical stone structure is on the left, with sailing ships docked behind it. The landscape extends towards the horizon where more ships are sailing. The etching features detailed linework, a monochromatic sepia tone, and a sky with fine lines suggesting clouds. Small birds are flying in the sky.

artworks.title: Design for a Fan: Courtly Figures in a Landscape
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 28.4 x 21.5 cm (11 3/16 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a decorative border featuring scroll and foliage motifs. The horizon is positioned slightly above the center, with buildings and trees reaching towards a cloudy sky. In the central scene, there are figures engaging in various activities. The etching technique uses fine lines to create texture and depth, particularly in the depiction of trees and clothing. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black and white for contrast and detail. Closest to the viewer, a group of figures interact, while smaller groups and individuals are scattered across the open space towards water and distant structures. The ornate frame accentuates the scene and its impact.

artworks.title: The Coronation of the Virgin with Angel Musicians and All Saints
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene filled with mythological and musical elements. The drawing features a complex arrangement of figures occupying the entire vertical space. At the top, a regal figure holds a crown, surrounded by various winged beings and cherubs. Towards the middle and bottom of the composition, numerous musical instruments are visible, including a large stringed instrument resembling a bass and a prominent organ being played by one of the figures. The detailed and intricate style of the drawing emphasizes fluidity and movement, enhancing its ornate and elaborate character.

artworks.title: The Way of Salvation
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on light brown laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene with angels and a central figure. Multiple winged cherubs surround the central figure holding a banner and cross. To the left, there are angelic figures. On the right, there are figures among ruins and trees. The drawing has intricate linework, shading, and a sense of dynamic movement.

artworks.title: A Sick Chicken
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting shows a woman standing in a grassy area. She is facing forward and looking down at a small white object she holds in her hands which vaguely resembles a small chick. A long white bonnet casts a shadow on her pale face. She wears a long-sleeved dress with light blue and white stripes with a black ribbon tied around her collar and a long brown apron around her waist. She stands on a wide patch of pale blue-green grass, and several brown and white chickens and small chicks walk in the grass around her. Behind her there are metal milk cans on the left, and on the right is a small red structure that could be a chicken coop. The background is filled by a large white building with a light brown porch and white beams supporting a white shingled roof. On the left is a window with dark green shutters, and in the center behind the woman is an open doorway. On the porch there is also a wooden chair and a wooden table with small pink and brown pots.

artworks.title: On the Fence
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: Two children are depicted in this painting. A young boy is sitting on a tree branch on the left, looking down at a girl on the right. The boy is barefoot, wearing a wide-brimmed straw hat, a long-sleeved brown shirt, suspenders, and yellow trousers. The girl is turned to the left and has her hands clasped around the tree branch above her. She has one leg bent and raised, her foot resting on a wooden fence that stretches across the bottom of the painting. She has a braided ponytail and is wearing a pale blue dress with elbow-length sleeves and ruffles around the waist. Both children have pale skin. The tree branch that the boy is sitting on and the girl is holding has many thinner branches connected to it, all covered in bright green leaves. The background shows soft mountains in blue and green under a pale, off-white sky.

artworks.title: On the Stile
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: A boy leads a girl by her hand across three wooden steps that allow for passage over a fence in this horizontal watercolor. The fence spans the width of the paper, but angles slightly away from us as it moves off to our left. The fence is made up of four widely spaced horizontal rails across vertical posts. The boy and girl face away from us but have pale or tanned skin and brown hair. The girl is on our side of the fence, her front foot on the top step. She wears a long white dress edged with ruffles and shaded with slate blue. Her hair is tied with a blue ribbon, and another ribbon flies from the back of her straw-colored hat. The boy begins to step down on the far side of the fence. He wears tan overalls, a gray shirt, and a wide-brimmed straw hat. The ankle we can see is bare. A tree branch with dark green leaves dips down into the scene from the upper right corner. A wash of dark green on the far side of the fence suggests a shrub in an otherwise flat field of fresh, celery green. The top rail of the fence overlaps the horizon, where a light blue hill rises to fill much of the upper half of the composition. A narrow wedge of cream-white sky angles into our view at the top left. The artist signed the lower right corner, “HOMER.”

artworks.title: Warm Afternoon
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and graphite on gray-green wove paper faded to brown
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting shows a pastoral landscape from a slightly elevated viewpoint. Closest to us, two sheep are lying down on a shaded green slope next to a person on the right, who is wearing a dark red garment with a blue headscarf. The person lays in the grass, resting one head on their hand, looking to the right. The person seems to have peach-toned skin, although details of their face are hard to discern. There appears to be a brown basket next to them. In the background, more white sheep graze across rolling green hills illuminated with light. On the left are a grove of tall trees, which cast shadows on the grassy ground. There are more green trees near the top right corner, below a cloudy blue sky. The brushstrokes in the painting are thick and visible.

artworks.title: The Green Hill
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and graphite on gray-green wove paper faded to brown
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting shows a green landscape with a horizon line about two-thirds up the frame. Trees dot the horizon, and a dark green hill rises in the distance. A red building is partially visible behind some green trees near the upper left corner. Closer to us, a woman sits on what seems to be a brown stone wall, facing the right. Her right arm is raised with her hand resting on her head, obscuring her face. She has pale skin and dark brown hair tied into a braid, and she wears a gray dress and black shoes. Behind her is a grassy green field that stretches towards the horizon. The sky above is mostly white, with some hints of light gray and pale blue painted with thick, light brushstrokes.

artworks.title: Native hut at Nassau
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite with scraping and blotting on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: This painting shows a white thatched-roof house on open, sandy ground. The brown thatched roof of the house has some yellow grass poking through. People can be seen in the open doorway of the house, identifiable by spots of red, blue, and light-yellow clothing. Behind the house is lush green tropical foliage with a few tall palm trees. A rooster is visible on the sandy ground in front of the house next to a long, white object that may be a downed tree trunk. The sky is filled with large white cumulus clouds and patches of bright blue.
